newsitem.title: USA: DIGEX completes Intermedia cash tender.
newsitem.headline: DIGEX completes Intermedia cash tender.

text.p: DIGEX Inc said the cash tender offer for its shares by Intermedia Communications Inc was successfully completed upon the offer's expiration July 9.
The merger will join DIGEX's premium Business Internet Connectivity and Complex Web Site Management capabilities with those of Intermedia, a communications services provider, DIGEX said.

Intermedia's depository for the offer indicates that about 11,556,536 shares of DIGEX common stock have been tendered and not withdrawn, representing about 96.7 percent of aggregate shares outstanding, DIGEX said.
Intermedia has indicated that it will proceed promptly to a merger pursuant to its agreement with DIGEX, the company said.
Any remaining public stockholders of DIGEX will be entitled to receive $13 cash per share in the merger, DIGEX said.
